notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Jirina Kudro.
When Jirina Kudro enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
